title: Spec docblock: FilterCondition form 4 says the nested-relation form is served "the same on every driver" by reading related ids, but drivers without readableIdsLeaf refuse it and SQL pushes it down as a subquery
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibvVRcFWKrfWeG5jzPb

Filing gate ①, Source: fleet. Found by the CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER review of PR #35574 (card #35494), record 7015837933 (§③, the dev's out-of-scope flag); on lines that PR does not change. Dedupe: `"same on every driver"` (0 open issues), `readableIdsLeaf docblock` (3 hits: #35494 open, the hop-limit sentence only; #34797 and #33876 closed, refusal message and engine refusal, not this docblock).

## What is false
`packages/spec/src/data/filter.zod.ts`, the form 4 paragraph of the `FilterCondition` docblock (about lines 2214–2229 at `b65488a8`), ships verbatim in `@objectstack/spec` (`files[]` carries `src/**/*.zod.ts`) and says three things the engine does not do:
1. "The query engine SERVES it in `where`, the same on every driver". On a driver that does not declare `readableIdsLeaf` (MongoDB, OData), a single-valued relation condition on a read verb is refused up front with `INVALID_FILTER` / 400: `packages/spec/src/data/driver.zod.ts:454`–462 and `relationReadDriverRefusal` in `packages/objectql/src/relation-filter-lowering.ts` (about :370). The hand-written page `content/docs/kernel/contracts/data-engine.mdx` already says "the same on every driver that serves it" (about :192) and states the refusal (about :225), so two published texts disagree.
2. "reads the related object with the condition AS THE CALLER … and matches the relation field against the ids it returns". On a SQL driver a read verb pushes the condition down as one subquery (PR #35423's verification: one statement, no related-id read), not an id read.
3. "A condition matching more related records than the engine's cap is refused rather than truncated". It holds only where ids are read; the subquery path caps nothing (`relation-filter-lowering.ts` module header, about :34–44).

reach: shipped text an author or agent reads (the docblock reaches the generated schema descriptions); measured by reading the cited code at `b65488a8`, not run.

## Done when
The paragraph states, per verb and driver capability, how the form is served (subquery push-down where the driver can, the bounded id read where it cannot prove the subquery, refusal on a driver without `readableIdsLeaf`), the cap sentence is scoped to the id-read path, and it agrees with `data-engine.mdx`. Text only, no behaviour change; a `patch` changeset on `@objectstack/spec` (the file ships).

## Business rationale
Builders and AI agents write filters from the spec's own docs. Told "same on every driver", an agent writing a MongoDB-backed app writes a nested-relation filter that the engine refuses at query time. Reader: the area:data lane seat that holds the filter docblock (d7-C today), one docs-only PR.

Grade: p2 · area:data · Bug · builders, often · evidence read (same class and reach as #35494, which triage graded p2: "a wrong sentence in shipped text is a Bug at that reach").
